output.summary: parseDate gains a required zone parameter and now appends 'Z' to the text when the zone is 'UTC'. All ten report functions are updated to pass 'UTC'.

groups.title: parseDate gains a zone parameter
groups.description: The signature changes and the parsed string depends on the zone. Check the behaviour for zones other than 'UTC', and for input text that already carries an offset.

groups.title: Reports pass 'UTC'
groups.description: Each of report1 to report10 makes the same one-line change to pass 'UTC'. Check that none should use another zone, and that no other callers of parseDate were missed.
